description: This file defines the onboarding interface and controller for a macOS application, including UI setup, state management, and interactions related to onboarding workflows, gateway discovery, and remote setup.

classes.name: OnboardingController
classes.description: A singleton controller class managing the onboarding window lifecycle, including showing, closing, and restarting the onboarding process.

methods.name: show
methods.description: Displays the onboarding window or performs preset actions based on the current process mode.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Closes the onboarding window if it is open.

methods.name: restart
methods.description: Restarts the onboarding process by closing and then showing the onboarding window.
